summary: Busy Clarence Road kerb with houses 6-9 m away and no parked cars.
reasons: No cars parked on this kerb

best_section.where: Clarence Road east kerb, midway down the stretch under street trees

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 8-9 m away either side of this gap; houses 16-17 m at 32-39 m on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a through carriageway; no lay-by, and the kerb is hemmed by trees and fences.
drivers.traffic: Busy through route linking Indooroopilly and Taringa; constant traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the west kerb, none on this one; a No Parking Any Time sign is nearby.

flags: No Parking Any Time sign 10.5 m off the kerb line
Dwellings within about 10 m along the whole stretch
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb; shade from the east.
